issue_request: FHIR-14232 was a Published/Persuasive technical correction for the Patient resource asking that the Patient.multipleBirth[x] comment spell "triplet" and "example" correctly instead of "tripplet" and "examle".
initial_application: Git commit 9ec491238348d5da09f2d1d85646a96723e4fcba applied the correction to the then-authoritative Patient spreadsheet source, changing "tripplets examle" to "triplets example" as part of Tracker #14024, #13949, #13953, and #14232.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists patient=Patient, confirming Patient is an active current build resource. The current authoritative Patient source is source/patient/structuredefinition-Patient.xml, where Patient.multipleBirth[x] contains the corrected wording. A whole-repository typo search found the old misspellings only in tools/history/release3/profiles-resources.xml, an archived release history artifact rather than the current Patient source. Zulip and Confluence searches found no relevant conflicting evidence.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because no current-source edit is needed and editing frozen release-history artifacts would not be a current-spec correction.
